wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Dahara Tower |image=Dahara Tower.png |imagesize=300px |characters=デセルタワー |japanese=Désert Tower |region=Kalos |colorscheme=ORAS |epicode=M18 |episode=Hoopa and the Clash of Ages }} '''Dahara Tower''' (Japanese: '''デセルタワー''' ''Désert Tower'') was an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]] that appeared in ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]''. It was built on the site where the [[Prison Bottle]] was made one hundred years ago and was meant to honor the [[Mythical Pokémon]] {{p|Arceus}}. One hundred years ago, the site of Dahara Tower was a barren rock near [[Dahara City]]. Foreseeing a cataclysmic battle between {{an|Hoopa}} [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Hoopa|Unbound]] and other [[Legendary Pokémon]] that would destroy Dahara City, Ghris traveled to this rock and created the Prison Bottle using earth, fire, and water. [[File:Dahara Tower Town Map.png|thumb|left|220px|Dahara Tower on {{an|Serena}}'s [[Town Map]]]] In ''[[Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon]]'', [[Baraz]] and [[Meray]] promised to meet each other at the Dahara Tower, as they had split ways in their search for the Prison Bottle. In ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to pay it a visit. Along the way they met up with Baraz, Meray, and Hoopa. When the Prison Bottle was accidentally destroyed, Hoopa's evil power manifested itself into a separate Hoopa Unbound. Baraz told the group that he would be able to restore the Prison Bottle at Dahara Tower. Meanwhile, Ash fought Hoopa Unbound and an array of Legendary Pokémon summoned by it. Hoopa Unbound eventually found out about what Baraz and Meray were trying to do, and had the Legendary Pokémon it had summoned attack Dahara Tower. {{p|Dialga}} destroyed part of the tower with {{m|Roar of Time}}. However, Baraz and Meray managed to create another Prison Bottle in time and stopped Hoopa Unbound. Although Dahara Tower and the city seemed safe now, time and space started to warp around the tower due to too many Legendary Pokémon having been summoned to one place. Ash transformed Hoopa into Hoopa Unbound using the new Prison Bottle, now not turning it evil because the evil power had disappeared. Hoopa Unbound managed to transport the people around the tower to a safe location with its rings. Dahara Tower was eventually consumed by the distortion and completely vanished, but not before Arceus appeared over Dahara City to save Baraz who had been trapped in the middle of the distortion. After this, Hoopa teleported Baraz, Meray, and Ash and his friends back to the site of Dahara Tower, where Hoopa promised it would restore Dahara Tower. ==In the manga== [[File:Dahara Tower M18 manga.png|thumb|250px|Dahara Tower in ''{{ma|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages}}'']] ===Movie adaptations=== Dahara Tower appeared in ''{{ma|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages}}''. {{sectionstub}} ==Trivia== ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} Dahara Tower corresponds to the {{wp|Burj Khalifa}}Location Scouting Report (Chapter 11: Burj Khalifa and the World's Greatest) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20180817104736/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/pokemovie_ch/?p=957 archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2015_xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa/xy_archdjinn_rings_hoopa_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]), currently the world's tallest structure located in {{wp|Dubai}}. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{colorschemedark|ORAS}}; border:3px solid #{{kalos color dark}}" |- !
